_comment: Illustrative list prices in USD per 1M tokens. Verify against the provider pricing page before relying on them for budgets. A (provider, model) pair that is not listed has an UNKNOWN cost (null), never 0. cached_input is the rate for tokens read from the prompt cache; cache_write is the rate for tokens written to it (Anthropic). Either may be omitted: cached tokens then bill at the input rate.
